heroSubheading: We sell, service and support your outdoor power equipment.
aboutHtml:
Bill and Shelley have owned and run STIHL SHOP Westport since July 2021. Our team specializes in selling outdoor power equipment and providing expert servicing and repairs. We stock STIHL, Masport, Cub Cadet, Rover, Honda, Hansa, Silky and Lawnmaster. You'll find our full range both in the shop and online, with home delivery and click and collect options for added convenience.

Bring your equipment to us for servicing, repairs or regular maintenance. We stock parts and provide advice when you need it. Whether you're shopping for something new or your gear needs fixing, we're here to help.

Come in and talk to us about your equipment needs. We're open Monday to Friday 8:30am to 5pm, and Saturday 9am to 1pm.
servicesIntro: Our workshop handles servicing, repairs and maintenance for all the brands we stock.
